strategies.name: DirectionAwareGating
strategies.thesis: Implementing direction-aware gating based on LONG vs SHORT asymmetry will improve performance.
strategies.signal_construction: Use separate LONG and SHORT models with asymmetric thresholds (e.g., LONG threshold = 0.6, SHORT threshold = 0.4).
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Current live gates do not account for direction asymmetry.

strategies.name: HourOfDayFilter
strategies.thesis: Excluding 6 UTC entries will improve performance.
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Current live gates do not account for hour-of-day filter.

strategies.name: BTC4hRegimeFilter
strategies.thesis: Rejecting LONG-only emitter LONGs when BTC 4h is red will improve performance.
strategies.signal_construction: Use a 10MA and 20MA crossover strategy to determine BTC 4h regime (e.g., LONG when 10MA > 20MA, SHORT when 10MA < 20MA).
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Current live gates do not account for BTC 4h regime filter.

edge10_corrections: Exclude entries between 6:00-6:59 UTC to improve performance.
edge11_proposals: Use a 10MA and 20MA crossover strategy to determine BTC 4h regime (e.g., LONG when 10MA > 20MA, SHORT when 10MA < 20MA).
Use a volatility band (e.g., 2% above/below 10MA) to filter out noise.
direction_gates: Use separate LONG and SHORT models with asymmetric thresholds (e.g., LONG threshold = 0.6, SHORT threshold = 0.4).
killers: Retire the existing live CRYPTO emitter that does not account for direction asymmetry and hour-of-day filter.
single_most_important_finding: Implementing direction-aware gating and hour-of-day filter can significantly improve performance.
